info.title: Loop Lore API
info.description: Loop Lore — SillyTavern RPG chat reimplementation API reference.

get.description: Returns server health status including provider connectivity. No authentication required.
List sessions for the authenticated user. Admin users see all sessions; regular users only see their own.
Get details for a specific session. Admin can view any session; regular users can only view their own.

delete.description: Force-logout a session. Admin can delete any session; regular users can only delete their own. Cannot delete current session (use /api/auth/logout instead).

get.description: List chats for the authenticated user, ordered by most recently updated.
